schemaVersion.description: Minor versions are additive; unknown fields are ignored; major versions get a new WebAPI slug (ingest-event-v2)

source.description: Registered source id (integrations form); drives severity/condition mapping

sourceEventId.description: Unique within source; idempotency key = tenantId|source|sourceEventId

resourceRef.description: Identifier exactly as the source emits it; resolved through the identifiers form

relatedResourceRef.description: Peer resource named by the alarm (e.g. X2 neighbour)

condition.description: Vendor condition code; mapped via engine/catalog.json conditionMap

vendorSeverity.description: Vendor-native severity; mapped via catalog severityMap; unmapped → Indeterminate + note
